from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-ws0/frozen/held-out-3/play/users/u053/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    pts8 = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r,c in pts8), max(r for r,c in pts8)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r,c in pts8), max(c for r,c in pts8)
    other = [(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0,8)]
    kr0, kr1 = min(r for r,c in other), max(r for r,c in other)
    kc0, kc1 = min(c for r,c in other), max(c for r,c in other)
    key = [row[kc0:kc1+1] for row in grid[kr0:kr1+1]]
    # Rotate the color key clockwise; each key cell controls an equally sized block.
    key = [list(row) for row in zip(*key[::-1])]
    sh = (r1-r0+1)//len(key)
    sw = (c1-c0+1)//len(key[0])
    for r,c in pts8:
        rr, cc = (r-r0)//sh, (c-c0)//sw
        color = key[rr][cc]
        if color:
            out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
path=programs/'task-07c19da1.py'
path.write_text(code)
